about.title: ABOUT
about.description: A2Z International Heavy Equipment Institute is Kerala's No.1 Heavy Equipment Training Institute. It provides a one-stop automated solution for the scarcity of skilled drivers and operators, offering various driver training programs. Students get tons of hands-on experience in their heavy-equipment programs.
